title: debug: dump palette predictions per transform
body:
Move the luma palette dump after coefficient decoding and use the
transform dimensions, matching the AVM trace. Leave palette prediction
itself at block level.

title: debug: remove unmatched scaled-MC diagnostics
body:
The scaled-MC offset and edge-emulation prints have no counterpart in
the AVM trace. Remove them while retaining the prediction and
reconstruction dumps.

title: avm: fix color-description trace labels
body:
Pass transfer characteristics and matrix coefficients in the order of
the printf labels. The parsed color values are unchanged.

title: avm: select TIP output-picture dumps
body:
Dump the synthetic TIP picture here only when it is an output picture,
and apply BLOCK_TO_DEBUG to its chunks. Reference predictions remain
covered by ordinary block dumps, as in dav2d.

title: avm: limit inter-prediction dumps to the selected region
body:
For a selected large block, dump only its first 64x64 prediction chunk,
matching the region selected by the dav2d instrumentation.

title: avm: print suffix metadata OBU headers
body:
Print the header for accepted suffix metadata and padding OBUs in the
second OBU-reading loop, as in the main loop.

title: avm: print derived segment IDs
body:
Print the spatially predicted segment ID before the skipped-block
early return. No entropy read is added.

title: avm: print zero for absent chroma grain fields
body:
Print zero for absent chroma grain multipliers and offsets instead of
subtracting the signed bias from an unsigned default-zero value.
